title: tonythetiger168/helioslm

description: Pure-PyTorch DeepSeek-V3/K3-style LLM stack where every serving optimization ships with a bit-exactness oracle: disk-tier expert streaming, KV prefix pool, MTP break-even telemetry, oracle-gated config evolution. 60 tests, all CPU-verified.
